rationale: Dimension Renewable Energy and Dimension Energy are the same US distributed-energy platform, with Dimension Energy LLC as the legal entity. Partners Group acquired control on June 24, 2021 and remains current. FTC Solar's approximately 23% interest was fully sold at closing; later disclosed financings are capital events rather than ownership transfers.
recommendedChanges: Create one canonical company named Dimension Energy with Dimension Renewable Energy as an alias.
Add Partners Group as the active controlling owner from 2021-06-24 without inventing an exact manager-level percentage or fund allocation.
Record FTC Solar as a former owner through 2021-06-24.
Keep PG Delta Holdco LLC as the ownership vehicle and exclude project LLCs, portfolios, tax-equity vehicles and assets.
unresolvedQuestions: Exact Partners Group stake, transaction price, fund allocation and primary-capital component are not publicly disclosed.
The full pre-close cap table and founder/angel rollover are not publicly disclosed.
Current minority members of PG Delta Holdco are not publicly disclosed.
